title: Integrate combo89 on dceb7bed: Opus3 6fce69dc (w-cee5 show a failed observation save on its merged test-run card; byte-identical carry of a2233c09)
outcome: The candidate is on master as one commit, gated by a full launcher run on the exact tree, pushed, and installed on Central and DL560.
acceptance: Commit 6fce69dc492a589f9e357912c50619716f582bcd (tree b89ebc9d6b43e0ba90d0f5b94f21f764dd785c77) is on origin/master, where master was moved to it by a fast-forward from dceb7bed42251bf3aeda89c88deac83194d777a7.

A full launcher run (node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit) on a test ref whose tree is b89ebc9d passed every stage, with equal source ids before and after and an eligible clean input, and no review finding of Medium or higher is outstanding: the candidate's contribution against dceb7bed is byte-identical (same 8 paths, equal pre-image and post-image blob ids, status and mode, compared without rename detection) to a2233c09's contribution against 8e4fd2f9, whose R1 review pair found no Medium or higher, and the candidate adopts that pair.

The release binary built from tree b89ebc9d was installed at target/release/termal(.exe) on Central and DL560, with the previous binary kept aside, and the running hosts were not restarted by the install; a later landing's install or a host restart's `cargo run --release` rebuild may since have replaced it, and only a replacing install keeps the replaced binary aside.
